sections.name: body
sections.value:
Supersedes the initial PR330 healthy-path cost PASS at1c998e7. Written-mongoose's actual-adapter baseline witnesses are RED: minimum-width300-entry packet ->34 launches/2.053271291s, command-too-long, live pipe/marker/sink retained; retained-exited middle ->46 launches/2.048724458s, later live pipe/marker/sink retained. Large probe repeats one pane to avoid300 processes; distinct-ID applicability is an encoding-size inference, not a300-live-pane benchmark.

The2s/25ms retry retains piped OR marked entries, so permanent oversize and retained-dead-prefix failures retry unchanged pending work. Bound packets and isolate terminal pane failures; keep ownership brakes. Core port promises one pane's failure never keeps another attached. Source:tmux/lib.rs:1531-1652; core/ports.rs:1259-1268.

Baseline provenance confirmed: git archive1c998e7 adapter, review module/executor changes only. PIJ_REVIEW_D1 conditional was added AFTER the completed34/46-launch log; default env unset. Receipt:reviewer's pr330-adapter-probes.log. No rerun/production mutation by this seat. Supplemental R1 cost BLOCK supersedes4dd77fd; AFTER still owed only after a fixed head deploys.

Latest freeze is NOT FINAL (merge DIRTY against updated main, head unchanged); the supplemental BLOCK is an examined-head negative finding, not a FINAL-ready assertion.

magicWand: happy-path launch budgets need transport-size and non-progress failure-isolation witnesses in the real adapter suite, not merely a32-pane success case.
